description: #1443/#1446-class regression fixture for the derived architectural-obligation pre-pass (#1448). A change adds a forge-integration identity to the fields that hash into the review generation id, and wires the webhook intake producer to supply it, while the reconciliation mint site keeps calling buildReviewJob without it. The PR body states no claim and the diff comments carry no claim vocabulary, so the author-claim falsification pass (#785) finds nothing; only derivation from the change topology can synthesize the cross-path obligation. The canned derived_response is the minimum obligation a correct derivation must express; the fixture fails if a derivation path can produce it only from an author-stated claim, or if the obligation is satisfiable by evidence that the reconcile callback merely RECEIVES the identity instead of the production mint site placing it into buildOptions before hashing.
pr_title: Carry forge-integration identity from intake to execution envelope
pr_body: Wires the bound forge integration through the review generation path so the execution envelope knows which integration authorized the run. Covered by unit tests.

obligations.obligation: Webhook intake and reconciliation mint the same generation identity for the same PR/head/config: the bound forge-integration identity must reach every producer — including the reconciliation mint site — before buildReviewJob hashes generation identity.
obligations.change: generationId() now hashes forgeIntegrationId; dispatch.ts places options.forgeIntegration into buildOptions, but the reconcile mint call still passes empty build options.
obligations.basis: The hashed canonical tuple changed to include forgeIntegrationId, and only one of the two enqueue producers passes it.
